statement.excerpt: This means that OpenAI would likely be burning more like $6 billion a year on server costs if it wasn’t so deeply wedded to Microsoft — and that's before you get into costs like staffing ($1.5 billion a year), and, as I've discussed, training costs that are currently $3 billion for the year and will almost certainly increase.

criteria.support_condition: Comparable realized annual training expenditure after 2024 exceeds the stated baseline, and a credible same-workload comparison supports approximately $6 billion in annual server costs without Microsoft's preferential terms.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive final accounting establishes no increase before training operations permanently cease, or a credible same-workload price comparison materially contradicts the approximately $6 billion counterfactual. An ordinary year without an increase does not defeat an undated forecast.
